description: Stylesheet for the home page layout and design of a tic-tac-toe web application, defining the visual appearance of various components including container, header, search bar, main content, games grid, and navigation.

classes.name: container
classes.description: Main container style for the home page that sets minimum height and layout attributes.

classes.name: header
classes.description: Styling for the header section including padding, display, and background color.

classes.name: search-bar
classes.description: Style for the search bar component with input and icon specifications.

classes.name: main-content
classes.description: Style for the main content area, allowing it to expand within the container.

classes.name: games-grid
classes.description: Styling for the grid layout of games, adapting to different screen sizes.

classes.name: bottom-nav
classes.description: Style for the bottom navigation bar, including layout and appearance.

classes.name: nav-item
classes.description: Style for individual navigation items within the bottom navigation.
